title: PostgreSQL OOMKilled under batch query load
summary: Database crashed with exit code 137 due to 64Mi container memory limit saturation during scheduled reporting queries.
resolution: Patched container memory limit from 64Mi to 256Mi and restarted dependent services.

title: Payment Service CrashLoopBackOff on missing Stripe secret
summary: Deployment v2.4.1 failed to initialize due to missing STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_V2 environment variable.
resolution: Rolled back deployment to v2.4.0 and re-applied Kubernetes secret injection.

title: Auth Service CPU saturation during token verification spike
summary: Bcrypt password hashing threads caused 98% CPU saturation and triggered upstream 502/504 errors.
resolution: Scaled auth-service deployment replicas from 1 to 3 and tuned HPA target.

title: Slow connection leak in PostgreSQL connection pool
summary: Unclosed database client connections gradually exhausted server memory over 4 hours.
resolution: Increased memory ceiling to 256Mi and restarted pooler proxy.

title: API Gateway route timeouts due to upstream network partition
summary: Corrupted kube-proxy iptables rule dropped traffic between edge gateway and backend tier.
resolution: Restarted kube-proxy daemonset and flushed iptables.
